text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Avoidable cost: an arm's cost minus the perfect forecast's, July 2025 to June 2026, Boston and Skegness. Cost is the energy proxy, GBP 2,000 x (MWh of generator output cut + 20 x MWh still over the limit). Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Right: avoidable cost if the price were GBP 100, 380 or 11,100 per MWh, and in the DCUSA form, which charges each instructed generator its whole headroom. Each limit is a multiple of the node's maximum export before July 2025. The NGED baseline is the maintainer's unconfirmed understanding of NGED's practice.'
text.tspan: Avoidable cost: an arm's cost minus the perfect forecast's, July 2025 to June 2026, Boston and
Skegness. Cost is the energy proxy, GBP 2,000 x (MWh of generator output cut + 20 x MWh still over
the limit). Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Right: avoidable cost if
the price were GBP 100, 380 or 11,100 per MWh, and in the DCUSA form, which charges each instructed
generator its whole headroom. Each limit is a multiple of the node's maximum export before July
2025. The NGED baseline is the maintainer's unconfirmed understanding of NGED's practice.
